summary: DeFi Technologies filed a Form 6-K furnishing a news release dated November 4, 2026, announcing a shareholder call for Friday, November 13, 2026 at 11:00 a.m. EST to discuss Q3 2026 financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026, with statements to be released after market close on November 12, 2026.
